subject: Mobile Development
title: Open Source as a Weapon
description: A short lesson to help you apply Open Source as a Weapon.

hook.text: Google made Android open source. Any manufacturer could use it for free.

buildup.text: Samsung, HTC, LG, and dozens more adopted Android. Competition drove prices down fast.

discovery.text: By 2011, Android had overtaken iOS in market share. By 2014, it was dominant.

twist.text: Google still controlled the Play Store and key apps. 'Open' had limits.

climax.text: Open source flooded the market with cheap smartphones, connecting billions of new users.

quiz.question: How did Android achieve dominant market share?
